a dialog with an explained control · hover the control · its explanation shows as a tooltip and no explanation text sits on the modal — here: as `demo_host` on `/frontdesk/assistant?tab=settings`, hover the lock of an engine row: the tooltip says why it is locked, and no such text sits in the row.

the screen's page with the data request failing · open the page · a readable error with a retry appears, not a blank page — here: as the platform admin, save a new engine number while the slot's API server is stopped (the agent stops it for this check and starts it again after): a readable error toast appears and the row keeps its old value.
On `/frontdesk/assistant?tab=flow` open any step: it shows what can stop it, and no «what this step reads»

decisions.text: behaviour: allowed ranges are quiet wait 1-10 s, longest wait 2-30 s, daily answers 1-2000, turn limit 1-50, follow-ups 0-10, history 2-40, glued messages 1-10, fact characters 1000-20000, first model 2-14 s, whole turn 10-60 s — reverse: edit ENGINE_SETTINGS in server/services/assistant-engine-settings.js

behaviour: saving a longest wait under quiet wait + 1 s is refused with 400, and raising the quiet wait lifts the longest wait in effect — reverse: drop the gap rule in limitsOf and accept lower saves
behaviour: for the platform admin an engine row shows the FoodVibe chip instead of the locked «קבוע במערכת» chip — reverse: remove the who.foodvibe swap in settings-table.component.html

behaviour: the number box opens on a line under its row, one at a time; it closes on a successful save and stays open after a failed one; opening another row drops the typed value — reverse: change startEdit and save in settings-table.component.ts
behaviour: «שמירה» is blocked for an empty or out-of-range number, with a tooltip saying why — reverse: remove aria-disabled and appTip from the save button and rely on the server's 400

behaviour: the save is PUT /api/v1/assistant-runs/engine-settings with one {field, value}; the history is not capped and the read cache lasts 5 s — reverse: change the route body, add a $slice, or change CACHE_MS
behaviour: the flow map's current-value lines also show seconds with one decimal — reverse: return a rounded number from engineAmount
behaviour: the model order row is unchanged because it already links the admin to the AI models manager — reverse: add the order as one more editable value
